scope: what each part of the twin that never ran needs before it can run: the tool and its witness, the inputs held and missing, what a contribution would have to hold, and the first steps once the inputs exist. A preparation: nothing here is a result

rules.note: the project measures nothing itself and pays nobody to measure; a contribution needs its capture protocol with instrument and uncertainty, an explicit licence grant, an identified specimen and a review independent of the contributor; no contributor is named here

parts.question: the flow through each port at stated valve lifts and pressure difference

tool.assigned: OpenFOAM with foamlib (docs/TOOLCHAIN.md); Gmsh for meshing (docs/AGENT_TOOL_GUIDE.md)
tool.witness_state: exists with its test (tests/test_openfoam_poiseuille_f25.py); to be rerun on the image used before any port case

held.standing: lofted over 57% and 44% of the centreline; 8% to 23% of the lofted wall is closure, not scan

held.what: the admissibility audit and its three gates
held.standing: both ports fail all three gates

held.what: two valve axes, seats and throats fitted on the scan
held.standing: nominal; one throat and one seat confirmed on held-out vertices (twins/935-cylinder-head-cad-twin/params/feature-check.json)

missing.what: registered sections of the port bend and of the valve pocket
missing.could_arrive_as: port moulds, a CT volume, or a borescope survey with sections registered to the flange face

missing.what: valve, seat and guide geometry of this head
which port is inlet and which is exhaust
missing.could_arrive_as: the same specification, or a marked photograph of the specimen

missing.what: valve lifts, pressure difference, air state and wall roughness for the cases
missing.could_arrive_as: a flow-bench protocol; a declared set makes a screen, not a comparison

missing.what: a measured flow number to compare with
missing.could_arrive_as: a flow-bench sheet of this head type; none is held

a_contribution_must_hold: the specimen: head type, part number or casting marks
the instrument, its resolution and a stated uncertainty
reference marks that tie the sections to the flange face and the valve axis
at least three dimensions that the twin already holds, for a scale check (the flange, the seat, the guide bore)
an explicit licence to use and redistribute the files
first_steps_once_unblocked: rebuild the port lofts through the new sections and rerun source/audit_port_domain.py: the three gates must pass
rerun the Poiseuille witness on the image used
mesh one port with the valve at one lift, checkMesh first, three mesh levels
report the discharge coefficient with its mesh sensitivity, beside the measured number if one exists
parts.runnable_today: nothing beyond the audit: a solver run on the present domain would measure the closure hypotheses and the missing valve

parts.state: blocked on a stress history and on material data
parts.question: damage of the head under a stated duty, for a stated alloy and process

tool.assigned: pyLife 2.3 (docs/TOOLCHAIN.md): rainflow counting, Wöhler curves, Miner damage
tool.on_this_host: pylife 2.3.1 in work/fatigue-venv of the main checkout, built from the hash lock
tool.witness_state: passed on 2026-11-10 (benchmarks/fatigue-postprocessor/results-20261110.json): rainflow against the ASTM E1049 table, Basquin and Miner against a closed form

held.what: temperature fields of the head in an assembly, four load cases
held.standing: a hypothesis screen: declared films and conductivities, no engine correlation

held.what: residual stress after the build, on voxel cells
held.standing: a screen: the stress sits on the declared yield curve and is not a prediction

held.what: published static strengths of the candidate alloys
held.standing: published values, most not re-read, none a design allowable
one point, fully reversed, room temperature, turned coupons, another machine: not a curve and not a part allowable

missing.what: a mechanical load case of the head: stud preload, gas pressure on the chamber, seat and guide press fits
missing.could_arrive_as: the stud specification and tightening procedure; peak cylinder pressure of a stated engine

missing.what: a converged stress field under that load case, cold and hot
missing.could_arrive_as: a CalculiX run on the assembly mesh with the thermal fields above, once the loads are stated

missing.what: an S-N curve for the alloy as printed, in the build direction, at the head's temperature
missing.could_arrive_as: a published curve read in its source, or coupon tests by a contributor; the repository admits no fatigue data today (docs/AGENT_TOOL_GUIDE.md)

missing.what: the duty: how many cycles at which load
missing.could_arrive_as: a declared duty makes a screen

a_contribution_must_hold: alloy, powder lot, machine, layer thickness, build orientation and heat treatment of the coupons
surface state (as built or machined), stress ratio, test temperature and run-out definition
the raw points, not only a fitted curve
an explicit licence to use and redistribute the data
first_steps_once_unblocked: write the load case beside the assembly thermal case, every value with its source
solve cold assembly and hot firing on the same mesh; mesh sensitivity at the three highest locations
rerun the pyLife witness, then count damage with the stated curve; report the sensitivity to the curve before any life
keep the result a screen: no life is stated for a part without process-specific data (docs/SAFETY.md)

held.what: the load-case contract for a valve cycle

a_contribution_must_hold: the specimen and the parts measured, with part numbers
instrument and uncertainty for each length, mass and spring force
the cam card with its reference lift and lash
an explicit licence to use and redistribute the data
first_steps_once_unblocked: write a parameter set for this head in the model's own format, every entry with its status and source
rerun the model's analytic checks, then spring margin and float speed over the stated speed range
check the valve-to-valve and valve-to-plug clearances on the fitted axes at full lift
